body.statement: Fix \(C<\infty\).  For any possibly abstaining rule whose probability of an incorrect classification is uniformly at most \(\alpha\) on \(\Theta_K\), there exists \(\kappa=\kappa(C,\alpha,m,M,d,E)>0\) such that along every sequence \(\theta_n\in\Theta_K\) with \(\delta_n(\theta_n)\le C\), the probability of correctly certifying \(h(\theta_n)\) is at most \(1-\kappa\).
body.justification: A matching impossibility result makes information distance a genuine certification boundary rather than only a sufficient margin.
body.gap: Weak-heteroskedasticity tests and repeated-eigenvalue analyses do not construct opposite labeled causal-target strata while preserving acyclicity, stationary confounding, measurement error, range inclusion, and positive noises.
body.consumer: The bound prevents overconfident effective-target declarations when covariance profiles are statistically indistinguishable.
